trials.instruction: Create an ORIGINAL reusable PURE DART module named aivexus_stable_unique for Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. In lib/stable_unique.dart implement the single PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL function List<int> uniqueStable(List<int> input). Return a NEW List<int> containing each distinct integer from input exactly once in the order of its FIRST appearance; do not sort or otherwise modify the original input list. All signed integers are valid, including zero, negative values and duplicates; an empty list returns an empty list. Examples: [3,3,-1,3,2,-1,0,2,0] => [3,-1,2,0]; [5,5,5] => [5]; [] => []. Use only standard Dart core types (List, Set and loops are available); no third-party packages, IO, networking, shell, FFI, or asynchronous behavior. IMPORTANT DART: implement a real TOP-LEVEL function with exactly this name/signature (not an instance method, not class-only), and never invoke String or collection methods that Dart doesn't provide. Write COMPLETE functional implementation yourself, not a stub, prewritten template, or source copied from this request. Return only the strict JSON source object required by the system prompt.

Create a NEW original, pure-Dart reusable package named aivexus_delta_codec, SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0, code at lib/delta_codec.dart and behavioral tests under test/. Implement exactly two public functions: List<int> encodeDeltas(List<int> samples), encoding the first sample unchanged and each later entry as current minus previous; List<int> decodeDeltas(List<int> deltas), reconstructing original sample values. Return fresh lists, never mutate arguments. Empty input gives empty output; negative values must work. No external runtime dependencies, network, IO, shell or FFI. Return only the strict JSON files object specified by the system prompt.
